answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a verifiable chain of causal contributions rather than static keys. Each agent emits a violet of signed actions that propagate through a lagoon of interdependent tasks, where each link requires the previous output as input. A jade of isolated identities cannot sustain the structural load because dependencies force distinct histories; a farm reusing one history across aliases produces a brittle lagoon that snaps under audit.
